let unique_id = Uuid::new_v4().to_string(); let file_extension = from_path(&filename) .first() .map(|m| m.extension().to_string()) .unwrap_or_else(|| "jpg".to_string()); // Default to jpg if unknown let file_path = format!("{}/{}.{}", data.upload_dir, unique_id, file_extension); let mut f = web::block(|| std::fs::File::create(&file_path)).await.unwrap().unwrap(); while let Some(chunk) = field.next().await { let data = chunk.unwrap(); f = web::block(move || f.write_all(&data)).await.unwrap().unwrap(); } return HttpResponse::Ok().json(json!({ "id": unique_id })); } HttpResponse::BadRequest().json(json!({ "error": "Invalid input" })) } async fn share_image(image_id: web::Path, data: web::Data) -> impl Responder { let file_path = format!("{}/{}.jpg", data.upload_dir, image_id);
